column1: # OWASP ZAP Baseline Ruleset for PunyaSitus (TASK-078 / REQ-078 / DEC-032)
# - Key High and Medium ZAP rules are explicitly set to FAIL so CI breaks on any
#   unaccepted High or Medium alert (`fail_action: true` in .github/workflows/security.yml).
# - Only explicitly justified benign Informational / Low rules are set to IGNORE so
#   CI does not fail permanently on accepted non-findings.
# --- Explicit FAIL rules (High / Medium / critical baseline hardening) ---

column3: Cookie No HttpOnly Flag: PunyaSitus mandates __Host- session cookies with HttpOnly.
Cookie Without Secure Flag: PunyaSitus mandates __Host- session cookies with Secure.
Anti-clickjacking Header Missing: HTML surfaces must emit X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors (tracked SEC-003).
X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing: HTML and API responses must emit nosniff (tracked SEC-003).
Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set: HTTPS targets must enforce HSTS at the Cloudflare edge or Worker.
Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set: All HTML surfaces must emit CSP (tracked SEC-003).
Cookie without SameSite Attribute: PunyaSitus mandates SameSite=Lax on __Host- session cookies.
CSP unsafe-inline / wildcard directive: Public and app CSP must eliminate script-src unsafe-inline (tracked SEC-006).
Cross Site Scripting (Reflected): Zero reflected XSS tolerated.
Cross Site Scripting (Persistent): Zero stored XSS tolerated.
Cross Site Scripting (Persistent - Prime): Zero stored XSS tolerated.
Cross Site Scripting (Persistent - Spider): Zero stored XSS tolerated.
SQL Injection: Zero SQL injection tolerated (parameterized Drizzle/D1 + plugin SQL guard).
Application Error Disclosure: Stack traces and internal error disclosures are forbidden.

column1: # --- Explicitly accepted benign Informational / Low rules (IGNORE) ---

column3: Informational/Low: Benign HTML/JS build comment scanner notice reviewed manually; does not indicate secret leakage.
Informational: Public marketing and tenant HTML pages are intentionally edge-cacheable with tenant+cacheVersion keys; private/admin/API routes enforce Cache-Control: no-store.
Informational: 128-bit Base64 CSP script nonces are emitted per response in <script nonce="..."> and Content-Security-Policy headers; not sensitive data disclosure.
Informational: Numeric epoch timestamps appear intentionally in public sitemap/JSON metadata and do not disclose internal state.
Informational: Modern Web Application detection notice (Astro SSR + Base UI islands); not a security vulnerability.
Informational: Passive ZAP detection of the public /auth/login authentication form; expected application behavior.

Low-confidence passive form notice: PunyaSitus auth and admin React islands submit application/json via fetch() protected by central server-side exact-Origin CSRF middleware (apps/web/src/middleware/csrf.ts), Better Auth trustedOrigins, and SameSite=Lax __Host- session cookies rather than hidden HTML form tokens.
Low: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy require-corp is intentionally omitted so Cloudflare Turnstile, privacy-enhanced YouTube, Google Maps embeds, and tenant R2/CDN assets load cleanly.
Informational: ZAP spider requests omit browser Sec-Fetch-Dest request headers; server-side CSRF and exact-Origin checks enforce mutation boundaries.
